reference: numpy.median and scipy.stats.median_abs_deviation(scale='normal') for each precursor's center and scale; numpy.nanpercentile(method='linear') and numpy.nanmedian for the per-run summaries; numpy.median of each run's finite fragment values for the transition rollup
note: 80 precursors x 12 runs, run 7 degraded. Per-run summaries are the exact numpy quantiles; PRISM reads them back from fixed-width histograms, so the test allows one bin width per quantity. Runs are in input order (acquisition order).
